mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 bc.content_type AS contentType, bc.genre AS genre FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = rl.content_id WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY rl.recommend_id DESC

SELECT TOP 1 c.content_id FROM erp_bookstore_priority p JOIN erp_bookstore_priority_draft d ON d.draft_id = p.draft_id AND d.is_active = 'Y' AND d.year = #{year} AND d.schoolyear = #{schoolyear} JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = p.content_id AND c.state = 'Y' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND rl.content_id = c.content_id ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_item i WHERE i.content_id = c.content_id AND i.center_code = #{centerCode} AND i.status = 'AVAILABLE' )
AND NOT ( #{lastType} IS NOT NULL AND #{lastGenre} IS NOT NULL AND c.content_type = #{lastType} AND c.genre = #{lastGenre} )
ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC

SELECT bc.content_id AS contentId, bc.original_title AS originalTitle, bc.author AS author, bc.publisher AS publisher, bc.summary AS summary, bc.keywords AS keywords, bc.image_url AS imageUrl, bc.content_type AS contentType, ct.codeNm AS contentTypeName, bc.genre AS genre, g.codeNm AS genreName, dc.name AS curriculumName, dr.name AS recommendOrgName, da.name AS awardName FROM erp_bookstore_content bc LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dc ON dc.content_id = bc.content_id AND dc.gubun = 'C' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dr ON dr.content_id = bc.content_id AND dr.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail da ON da.content_id = bc.content_id AND da.gubun = 'A' WHERE bc.content_id = #{contentId}

SELECT TOP 1 bc.content_id AS contentId, bc.original_title AS originalTitle, bc.author AS author, bc.publisher AS publisher, bc.summary AS summary, bc.keywords AS keywords, bc.image_url AS imageUrl, bc.content_type AS contentType, ct.codeNm AS contentTypeName, bc.genre AS genre, g.codeNm AS genreName, dc.name AS curriculumName, dr.name AS recommendOrgName, da.name AS awardName FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = rl.content_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dc ON dc.content_id = bc.content_id AND dc.gubun = 'C' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dr ON dr.content_id = bc.content_id AND dr.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail da ON da.content_id = bc.content_id AND da.gubun = 'A' WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND rl.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY rl.recommend_id DESC
SELECT TOP 1 recommend_id AS recommendId, status AS status, grade AS grade FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND content_id = #{contentId} ORDER BY recommend_id DESC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log (recommend_id, student_id, content_id, qlevel, qnum, selected, is_correct, qtype) VALUES
(#{recommendId}, #{studentId}, #{contentId}, #{qlevel}, #{a.qnum}, #{a.selected}, #{a.correct}, #{a.qtype})
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_recommend_log SET correct_count = #{correctCount}, total_count = #{totalCount}, grade = #{grade}, status = #{status} , completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE recommend_id = #{recommendId}
mapper.select: SELECT level_no AS levelNo, required_exp AS requiredExp FROM erp_bookstore_level ORDER BY level_no ASC

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) c.content_id AS contentId, c.original_title AS originalTitle, c.image_url AS imageUrl, 'DONE' AS status FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = rl.content_id WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND rl.status = 'DONE' AND YEAR(rl.completed_at) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND MONTH(rl.completed_at) = MONTH(GETDATE()) ORDER BY rl.completed_at DESC
SELECT level_no AS levelNo, level_name AS levelName, feature AS feature, required_exp AS requiredExp FROM erp_bookstore_level WHERE level_no = #{levelNo}
SELECT badge_id AS badgeId, badge_name AS badgeName, badge_desc AS badgeDesc, category AS category, threshold AS threshold, param AS param FROM erp_bookstore_badge ORDER BY badge_id ASC

SELECT b.badge_id AS badgeId, b.badge_name AS badgeName, b.badge_desc AS badgeDesc, b.category AS category, b.threshold AS threshold, b.param AS param FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb JOIN erp_bookstore_badge b ON b.badge_id = sb.badge_id WHERE sb.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sb.earned_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'DONE'

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), completed_at, 126) AS yearMonth, COUNT(*) AS count FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'DONE' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(7), completed_at, 126) ORDER BY 1 ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND grade = 'KING'

WITH pass_session AS ( SELECT s.recommend_id, MIN(s.submitted_at) AS submitted_at FROM ( SELECT a.recommend_id, a.submitted_at, SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_cnt, MAX(r.total_count) AS total_cnt FROM erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log a JOIN erp_bookstore_recommend_log r ON r.recommend_id = a.recommend_id AND r.status = 'DONE' WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.qlevel = '01' GROUP BY a.recommend_id, a.submitted_at ) s WHERE s.total_cnt IS NOT NULL AND s.correct_cnt >= CEILING(s.total_cnt * 2.0 / 3) GROUP BY s.recommend_id ), per_type AS ( SELECT ps.recommend_id, a.qtype, MIN(CAST(a.is_correct AS INT)) AS all_correct, COUNT(*) AS answered_cnt, MAX(tq.qtype_total) AS qtype_total FROM pass_session ps JOIN erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log a ON a.recommend_id = ps.recommend_id AND a.submitted_at = ps.submitted_at AND a.qlevel = '01' JOIN ( SELECT content_id, qtype, COUNT(*) AS qtype_total FROM erp_bookstore_itempool WHERE qlevel = '01' AND state = 'S' GROUP BY content_id, qtype ) tq ON tq.content_id = a.content_id AND tq.qtype = a.qtype GROUP BY ps.recommend_id, a.qtype ) SELECT qtype AS qtype, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM per_type WHERE all_correct = 1 AND answered_cnt >= qtype_total GROUP BY qtype

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.content_id) FROM ( SELECT a.content_id, a.submitted_at, SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_cnt, MAX(t.total_cnt) AS total_cnt FROM erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log a JOIN ( SELECT content_id, COUNT(*) AS total_cnt FROM erp_bookstore_itempool WHERE qlevel = '02' AND state = 'S' GROUP BY content_id ) t ON t.content_id = a.content_id WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.qlevel = '02' GROUP BY a.content_id, a.submitted_at ) s WHERE s.total_cnt > 0 AND s.correct_cnt >= s.total_cnt
mapper.update: MERGE erp_bookstore_student_info AS target USING (SELECT #{studentId} AS student_id) AS source ON target.student_id = source.student_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET exp = target.exp + #{expGained}, level_no = #{levelNo}, books_read = target.books_read + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (student_id, exp, level_no, books_read) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{expGained}, #{levelNo}, 1);
